messages:
Lina Gomez: Quick callout — prepping the lights-out EU midnight window (00:00 UTC). Need rollforward owner + emergency-unpin owner. Also confirm release notes link and canary size. TL;DR: aiming for v2026-03-21-rc3 to prod.
Sam O'Neill: I'm on rollforward (Sam). Will monitor metrics and initiate rollforward if error rate > 0.8% for 5m.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled canary: route=prod-eu, version=v2026-03-21-rc3, canary=10%, start=00:05 UTC. Ack.
Alice Chen: putting @Ben on emergency-unpin. Ben, can you standby to run emergency-unpin and pin old version?
Ben Kumar: onstandby. Emergency unpin command in case:
```
/deploy-bot emergency-unpin prod-eu
/deploy-bot pin prod-eu --version=v2026-03-21-stable
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/ri-inference --to-revision=PREV
```
Rachel Park: release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21/notes. Smoke tests:
```
curl -sS https://smoke.prod.redwood/ping && curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.prod.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
```
Alice Chen: two quick asks — 1) Confirm observability dashboard link, 2) confirm change-window freeze: 23:50-00:15 UTC. No schema migrations during that slot.
Sam O'Neill: Dash: https://grafana/redwood/d/ops/prod-eu-canary. I'll add a dashboard row for 95th latency + error rate.
DeployBot: Canary started at 00:05 UTC. Logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/3303018274. Status: healthy so far (0.02% errors).
Lina Gomez: thanks. If we need rollback, prefer 'rollforward to stable' unless data loss risk — Sam, you have authority to roll? Otherwise we execute emergency unpin.
Sam O'Neill: I have authority. My escalation is @Alice if infra-level.
Ben Kumar: noted. I'll be ready to run emergency-unpin by CLI at 00:07 UTC if invoked. Reaction: :thumbsup:
Rachel Park: adding a quick checklist: 1) Release notes link, 2) Smoke pass, 3) Dash green, 4) No spikes in queue depth. All done? Reply 'go' to proceed.
Alice Chen: go
Lina Gomez: deploying to full at 00:20 if canary stable. Keep this channel for minute-by-minute updates. Adding runbook snippet for emergency procedure:
```
# Emergency unpin runbook (summary)
1. /deploy-bot emergency-unpin prod-eu
2. pin stable: /deploy-bot pin prod-eu --version=v2026-03-21-stable
3. confirm infra: kubectl get pods -n prod | grep ri-inference
4. notify #incidents and customers@ops
```
DeployBot: Canary ramp at 00:20 -> 50%. Monitoring.
Sam O'Neill: seeing higher p95 on a small shard — investigating. ETA 3m.
Ben Kumar: if Sam calls it, I'll run unpin. Otherwise standby.
Rachel Park: updating release notes with rollback decision text.
Lina Gomez: thanks team. End log: last update 00:23 UTC — canary ramp halted at 50%, Sam investigating; channel will remain open for roll action.
